what: Speed of light (docs/v2/plan/lanes/core/speed-of-light.md, kqueue section). (1) fs::stamps caps its threads at 8; take one thread per 2,048 names up to available_parallelism, as iocp/stamp.rs sweepers() now does: 50,000 stamps go from 2.5 ms to 1.25 ms on 16 cores. Keep the order of the result exactly. (2) fs::entries on macOS: one getattrlistbulk call per buffer of entries with their attributes, in place of readdir plus an fstatat per entry; prove equal to today with a differential test over random trees.
